text:
taylor: Follow-up from the 23:10 UTC incident — after-hours schema migration caused a short flurry of alerts that paged the on-call. Dropping owners and short actions here.

mina: Summary: migration workers retried failed shards; retries surfaced transient validation errors. Alerts were P2 and paged SRE directly; dedupe failed because fingerprint used `attempt_id`. Routing also lacked quiet-window suppression for migrations.

omar: I'll own thresholds and severity tuning. Plan: lower severity to P4 for validation-errors during migration windows and add a conditional that uses job_phase=="post-migrate". Target: Thu EOD.

devon: I'll fix dedupe: change fingerprint to hash(table, shard, error_code) and extend dedupe window to 25m. I'll open PR and test with a replay. Target: Mon.

rachel: I'll update routing rules so migration.* alerts go to infra-migrations team with a 45m fallback to platform-sre. Also add a quiet-window config for 02:00-05:00 UTC. Target: Fri.

mina: runbook change: add an "in-migration" suppression mode that requires `migration_id` to be present and includes an override for critical failures. Draft suppression snippet below for review:
```json
{"name":"migration-quiet-mode","match":"migration_id != null && severity == \"P4\"","suppress_for_minutes":300,"notify_channel":"#infra-migrations"}
```

sys-bot: ticket created: PM-9108 "Tune alerts: migration quiet window + dedupe" assigned to @omar @devon @rachel @mina — https://issues.redwood.example/PM-9108

taylor: Please post a 1-line status update when you progress; I'll include in the postmortem action tracker before the ops review.

omar: status: baselined 48h of logs; proposing P4 for validation-errors during migration windows, will open PR to alert rules tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

devon: status: PR #518 opened in observability; running staging replay now. saw ~76% reduction in duplicates so far. :construction:

rachel: status: routing PR in review, canary scheduled Sat 03:00 UTC for infra-east. quiet-window config added.

mina: status: runbook updated and pushed; security review requested. linking runbook: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/migration-quiet-mode

taylor: Next steps: if staging looks good, target prod flip Mon 02:00 UTC. I'll attach a small eval set to Redwood Optimize to validate no real incidents are suppressed.

omar: will add 20 migration traces to the Optimize eval set.

devon: if duplicates remain >20% after 1w, we'll iterate on grouping keys.

rachel: after canary, I'll flip in prod during the maintenance window and update PM-9108.

taylor: final: please update PM-9108 with canary and prod statuses and close when all owners confirm success. Also adding an incident signature (owner: taylor) to recurring-incidents so detectors can auto-match this pattern in the future. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
